title: Sini-Suanzaoren decoction regulates mitochondrial biogenesis mediated by MT-SIRT1 in the treatment of insomnia rats.
authors: Li, Ru-Ting; Lan, Bi-Juan; Xiao, Zhuo-Yang; Shi, Qing-Huan; Chen, Xin-Yi; Li, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方治疗失眠的线粒体生物合成机制，仅涉及小分子与SIRT1蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Insomnia is closely associated with anxiety and depression, with its pathogenesis involving biological, psychological, and social factors. Sini powder and Suanzaoren decoction are clinically effective traditional Chinese medicine formulas for insomnia, demonstrating promising bioactivity. However, the capability of the active components of Sini-Suanzaoren decoction (SNSZRD) to cross the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and their precise molecular mechanisms, particularly concerning the MT-SIRT1 pathway and mitochondrial function, remain largely unexplored. AIM: To elucidate the bioactive components of SNSZRD that are capable of BBB penetration and investigate the therapeutic mechanism of SNSZRD against insomnia. METHODS: The chemical components of SNSZRD were analyzed through liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS). Male Sprague-Dawley rats were intraperitoneally injected with DL-4-chlorophenylalanine (PCPA) to establish an insomnia model. Rats were divided into control, model, eszopiclone (positive control), and SNSZRD low-/medium-/high-dose groups. Molecular docking predicted BBB-penetrating components and their binding affinity for SIRT1. Key pathways were analyzed through open-field tests, elevated plus-maze tests, pentobarbital-induced sleep experiments, Haematoxylin and eosin staining, Nissl staining, ELISA, Western blot analysis, quantitative real-time PCR, and immunohistochemistry. RESULTS: LC-MS identified 1574 compounds in SNSZRD, of which eight prototype components (e.g., pachymic acid and senkyunolide G) could cross the BBB. Molecular docking revealed that these components formed stable hydrogen bonds with the SIRT1 protein. SNSZRD treatment significantly ameliorated PCPA-induced anxiety-like behaviors and sleep latency/sleep duration, as well as reduced neuronal degeneration and Nissl body loss in the hypothalamus of treated rats. Additionally, SNSZRD elevated serum melatonin and hypothalamus ATP levels and upregulated the mRNA and protein expression levels of arylalkylamine N-acetyltransferase, SIRT1, PPARgamma coactivator-1alpha, nuclear respiratory factor-1, and mitochondrial transcription factor A in the MT-SIRT1-mitochondrial biogenesis pathway. CONCLUSION: SNSZRD might exert its therapeutic effects on insomnia by modulating MT-SIRT1 axis-regulated mitochondrial biogenesis in rats and might serve as an effective therapeutic agent for insomnia.
abstract_zh: 背景：失眠与焦虑和抑郁密切相关，其发病机制涉及生物、心理和社会因素。四逆散和酸枣仁汤是临床上治疗失眠有效的中药方剂，显示出良好的生物活性。然而，四逆-酸枣仁汤（SNSZRD）活性成分穿越血脑屏障（BBB）的能力及其精确分子机制，特别是涉及MT-SIRT1通路和线粒体功能方面，仍 largely 未被探索。目的：阐明SNSZRD中能够穿透BBB的生物活性成分，并研究SNSZRD对抗失眠的治疗机制。方法：通过液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）分析SNSZRD的化学成分。雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠腹腔注射DL-4-氯苯丙氨酸（PCPA）建立失眠模型。大鼠分为对照组、模型组、艾司佐匹克隆（阳性对照）组以及SNSZRD低/中/高剂量组。分子对接预测了BBB穿透成分及其与SIRT1的结合亲和力。通过开放场实验、高架十字迷宫实验、戊巴比妥诱导睡眠实验、苏木精-伊红染色、尼氏染色、ELISA、Western blot分析、实时定量PCR和免疫组织化学分析关键通路。结果：LC-MS在SNSZRD中鉴定出1574种化合物，其中八种原型成分（如茯苓酸和川芎内酯G）能够穿越BBB。分子对接显示这些成分与SIRT1蛋白形成稳定氢键。SNSZRD治疗显著改善了PCPA诱导的焦虑样行为及睡眠潜伏期/睡眠持续时间，并减少了治疗大鼠下丘脑中的神经元变性和尼氏体丢失。此外，SNSZRD提高了血清褪黑素和下丘脑ATP水平，并上调了MT-SIRT1-线粒体生物发生通路中芳基烷基胺N-乙酰转移酶、SIRT1、PPARγ共激活因子-1α、核呼吸因子-1和线粒体转录因子A的mRNA和蛋白表达水平。结论：SNSZRD可能通过调节大鼠中MT-SIRT1轴调控的线粒体生物发生发挥其治疗失眠的作用，并可能作为失眠的有效治疗药物。
